purpose: Replay only the current Automatic Router and selected Persona Generator against ten saved B-arm trajectories; do not rerun or score the main model

source.tasks: t01 through t10 in the prior fixed order

input_policy.t01_to_t09: Rebuild the bounded packet from the saved turn state through the first evidence record categorized as change.
input_policy.t10: The old hook missed its file change. Extract the first recorded apply_patch call from the saved B-arm rollout and render it with the current change evidence contract.
input_policy.immutability: Write inputs.json before any Provider call and record a SHA-256 for every source packet.

apparatus.calls_per_finding_attempt: Router followed by exactly one selected Persona Generator

amendments.change: Added the explicit no-selective-rerun policy after t09 produced invalid_output. The task was not rerun, but this policy was not preregistered.

outcomes.interpretation: This measures Reviewer behavior on frozen or explicitly reconstructed inputs. It does not measure task-solving efficacy, main-model adoption, or causal impact.
outcomes.rerun_policy: After Provider calls begin, retain invalid output and timeout outcomes. Do not selectively rerun one task; another full replicate requires a separate preregistered artifact.
